items.name: RNN
items.note_body:
-What was used prior to transformer discovery
-A class of artificial neural network designed to process sequential data.
-Processes one word at a time

items.name: CNN
items.note_body:
-Used for spatial data (ex. images)
-Grid shaped neural net

items.name: Andrej Karpathy
items.note_body:
-One of the world’s best educators on deep learning and LLMs.
-Former Director of AI at Tesla
-Founding member of OpenAI

items.name: John McCarthy
items.note_body:
-Father of Artificial Intelligence
-Coined the term “Artificial Intelligence”

items.name: Geoffrey Hinton
items.note_body: Popularized back propagation in NNs, amongst other things.

items.name: Noam Shazeer
items.note_body:
-Co-author of Attention Is All You Need
-Pioneered Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)

items.name: Yann Lecon
items.note_body: Known for developing CNNs

items.name: Richard Sutton
items.note_body:
-Father of Reinforcement Learning
-Established reinforcement learning (RL) as a major branch of machine learning.
-Author of a bitter lesson

items.name: Yoshua Bengio
items.note_body: Known for making advancements in NN training

items.name: Ilya Sutskever
items.note_body:
-One of the architects behind today’s large language models.
-Founding member of OpenAI

items.name: Jared kaplan
items.note_body: -Developed the influential Scaling Laws paper while at OpenAI, showing how model performance improves predictably with more parameters, data, and compute. -Later co-founded Anthropic.

items.name: John Jumper
items.note_body: Led development of AlphaFold at Google DeepMind, revolutionizing protein structure prediction.

items.name: Illia Polosukhin
items.note_body: -Co-authored Attention Is All You Need before leaving Google.

items.name: Łukasz Kaiser
items.note_body: -Co-authored the Transformer paper and developed tools like Tensor2Tensor that made experimentation with neural architectures easier.

items.name: Aidan N. Gomez
items.note_body: -Co-authored Attention Is All You Need while at the University of Toronto

items.name: llion jones
items.note_body: -Co-authored the Transformer paper and later worked on large-scale AI systems and startup ventures.

items.name: Jakob Uszkoreit
items.note_body: -Co-author of the Transformer paper and early advocate for replacing recurrent networks with attention mechanisms.

items.name: Niki Parmar
items.note_body: -Helped design and implement the original Transformer while at Google
